RUNEPRIEST-PULSING_PEDESTAL.title: Pulsing Pedestal
RUNEPRIEST-PULSING_PEDESTAL.pages.INITIA:
A strange pedestal stands in the middle of a darkened room, [sine][aqua]pulsing and humming[/aqua][/sine] with a pale blue glow.

On its surface is a slot, just the size of a rune.
Choose a rune card. [blue]{UpgradeChance}%[/blue]: [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it. [blue]{RemoveChance}%[/blue]: [red]Remove[/red] it from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Requires a rune card that can be [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-PULSING_PEDESTAL.pages.UPGRAD: The rune sinks into the slot. The hum rises to a [jitter]shriek[/jitter]—then the pedestal spits it back out, [gold]glowing brighter than before[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-PULSING_PEDESTAL.pages.CONSUM:
The rune sinks into the slot. The glow flares, then [red]goes out[/red].

The pedestal is silent. Your rune does not come back.
You leave the pedestal to its humming.
RUNEPRIEST-SUSPICIOUS_TAILOR.title: Suspicious Tailor
RUNEPRIEST-SUSPICIOUS_TAILOR.pages.INITI:
A [orange]horned shopkeeper[/orange] catches your eye. Their stall holds only one item: a robe, light as breath.

A hissed voice: [sine]"How would you like to trade clothes?"[/sine]
Add a [gold]Blood Rune[/gold] to your deck.
RUNEPRIEST-SUSPICIOUS_TAILOR.pages.TRADE:
The robe settles on your shoulders. It weighs nothing at all.

When you look up, the stall is gone, and something [red]warm[/red] runs down your arm.
RUNEPRIEST-SUSPICIOUS_TAILOR.pages.DECLI: "[sine]Another time, then.[/sine]" The shopkeeper smiles with too many teeth and presses a small, [red]warm[/red] stone into your palm. A rune you never carved glistens on it.
RUNEPRIEST-ENCHANTED_FORGE.title: Enchanted Forge
RUNEPRIEST-ENCHANTED_FORGE.pages.INITIAL:
A [gold]golden anvil[/gold] stands in a ring of heat. Molten silver pours through the cracks in the cobbled floor, steaming as it goes.

The forge will not let you leave empty-handed.
Merge [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Common rune cards into a [gold]Forged Rune[/gold]. Add [red]Clumsy[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-ENCHANTED_FORGE.pages.FORGE.d:
[b][jitter]CLANG![/jitter][/b] The runes run together on the anvil and set into one.

The silver splashes your hands. They never quite stop [red]trembling[/red].
RUNEPRIEST-ENCHANTED_FORGE.pages.DISSOLV: You drop your coins into the silver. The forge takes them, and something you carried, and lets you go.
RUNEPRIEST-ENCHANTED_FORGE.pages.NOTHING: The anvil cools. Nothing was forged.
